name: Exp_CandlesticksBW_Tm
summary: This EA identifies black and white candlestick patterns (Engulfing/Harami style) to generate trade signals, with time-filtered trading sessions and a trailing stop mechanism. It enters long on bullish candlestick reversals and short on bearish candlestick reversals, using fixed lot sizing and optional time-based trade restrictions.
summary_zh: 该EA通过识别黑白K线形态（吞没/孕线类）生成交易信号，支持时段过滤和追踪止损机制。在看涨K线反转时做多，看跌K线反转时做空，使用固定手数和可选的时间交易限制。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于黑白K线形态识别，即通过比较前后两根K线的实体大小和方向来判断趋势反转信号。当出现看涨吞没或看涨孕线形态时，EA开多单；当出现看跌吞没或看跌孕线形态时，EA开空单。出场条件依赖追踪止损机制，在价格朝有利方向移动后锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏最大持仓限制和每日亏损限额等保护机制。时间过滤功能允许用户限制EA仅在指定时段内交易，有助于避开低流动性时段。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on black and white candlestick pattern recognition, comparing the body size and direction of two consecutive candles to identify trend reversal signals. When a bullish engulfing or bullish harami pattern appears, the EA opens a long position; when a bearish engulfing or bearish harami pattern appears, it opens a short position. Exit conditions rely on a trailing stop mechanism that locks in profits after price moves favorably. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management lacks protective mechanisms such as maximum position limits or daily drawdown caps. The time filter feature allows users to restrict trading to specified sessions, helping avoid low-liquidity periods.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, martingale base quantity

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

pros: 基于经典K线形态，策略逻辑直观易懂
支持时段过滤，可避开不利交易时段
追踪止损机制有助于保护已有利润
信号条件明确，不会产生模糊交易信号
pros_en: Based on classic candlestick patterns with intuitive and easy-to-understand logic
Time session filter helps avoid unfavorable trading periods
Trailing stop mechanism helps protect existing profits
Clear signal conditions without ambiguous trade entries
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户规模和波动率，资金管理粗糙
止损默认为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一周期K线形态容易产生假信号
没有持仓数量限制，可能在震荡市中连续开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在宽点差时段可能不利入场
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing ignores account size and volatility, crude money management
Stop loss defaults to 0, creating unlimited loss risk
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single-period patterns prone to false signals
No position count limit, may open consecutive positions in ranging markets
No spread filter, may enter at unfavorable wide-spread periods
improvements: 增加动态仓位计算，根据ATR或账户风险比例调整手数
添加多时间框架确认机制，如H4趋势方向配合H1形态入场
加入点差过滤和最大持仓限制，降低不利市场条件下的风险暴露
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage
Add multi-timeframe confirmation such as H4 trend direction with H1 pattern entry
Add spread filter and maximum position limit to reduce risk exposure in adverse market conditions

risk_points: 止损默认为0，单笔交易可能承受巨大亏损
无最大持仓限制，震荡行情中可能连续开仓导致过度暴露
单一K线周期形态确认不足，假信号风险高
risk_points_en: Stop loss defaults to 0, single trade may suffer huge losses
No maximum position limit, consecutive entries in ranging markets may cause overexposure
Single-timeframe candlestick confirmation insufficient, high false signal risk

It enters long on bullish candlestick reversals and short on bearish candlestick reversals, using fixed lot sizing and optional time-based trade restrictions.
